title: Anwendung im Layout
slide_intent: Relate the identity element to edges, text and image meaning so placement contributes to reading.
strategic_value: The Schwelle can connect varied DB layouts without requiring a single rigid composition.
demonstration: Edge-placement diagrams precede subtle background examples and four contextual uses involving movement, people, routes and headlines.
practical_value: Choose an edge, background or content-related placement; preserve the distinct color, overlap and small-size conditions.

reference_purposes.Intent: The copy links contextual placement to supporting a message and visual dynamics.
